test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 1. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad0248eb6bbee1cdb12e9209089c8859f25a815b041f73cb9e28a838e4cd7418.png]
solution:
From the given two dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20d1da6e774608aa00816d0205b6c1b69087170f3736afca126a03ea2d38502d.png] 

→ 3 and 2 are common surface in both Dice, therefore, '4' is the opposite surface of '1'.

Here, '4' is opposite to the face containing '1'.

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
